import re

# Strip ANSI escape codes
ansi_clean = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', docx_output)

# Remove the OBSERVATION prefix
obs_prefix = "OBSERVATION: The following is the content from the word file:\n"
if obs_prefix in ansi_clean:
    paragraph_text = ansi_clean.split(obs_prefix, 1)[1]
else:
